verdict.rationale: Whether the source is open is a fair question for a SaaS email platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Loops publishing its own source code under an open license. The published OpenAPI spec, the CLI install options and the skills package (loops-so/skills) are integration artifacts, not the product's source, and none of them has a stated license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
